columns_read_from_csv: only SOURCE_COLUMNS (ml/feature_config.py); all other columns never loaded
dtype_strategy: all text read as str per chunk, then float32 / datetime64 / str; chunk size 100000
special_code_policy: DfT missing/unknown codes -> category 'unknown' (kept, not imputed); speed_limit outside {20..70} -> NaN -> median imputation + missing indicator
high_cardinality_geography_decision: latitude/longitude/LSOA/local-authority/police-force NOT used as features (location memorisation, reporting-practice bias, thousands of levels); coordinates rounded to 2 dp are kept only for the historical map.
outlier_policy: number_of_vehicles winsorised at 10; no rows removed for outliers

reasons.hour: Hour of day (0-23) from the recorded collision time; risk and traffic mix vary through the day.
reasons.hour_sin: Cyclical encoding of hour so 23:00 and 00:00 are neighbours (helps linear models).
reasons.is_night: Hour >= 21 or < 6; proxy for reduced visibility and fatigue/impairment (approximate, ignores season).
reasons.is_rush_hour: Weekday 07-09 or 16-18; congestion lowers speeds but raises collision counts.
reasons.is_weekend: Weekend flag; leisure traffic differs from commuter traffic.
reasons.junction_group: Junction detail collapsed to no_junction / roundabout / t_junction / crossroads_multi / slip_road / private_drive / other / unknown.
reasons.lighting_group: Light codes collapsed to daylight / dark_lit / dark_unlit / unknown.
reasons.month: Month of year from collision date; captures seasonal effects.
reasons.multi_vehicle: More than one vehicle involved; single-vehicle crashes have a different severity profile.
reasons.road_type_group: Road type collapsed to roundabout / one_way_or_slip / dual_carriageway / single_carriageway / unknown.
reasons.speed_band: Speed limit grouped (<=20, 30, 40-50, 60, 70, unknown); kinetic energy rises non-linearly with speed.
reasons.surface_group: Surface codes collapsed to dry / wet / snow_ice / contaminated / unknown.
reasons.weather_group: Weather codes collapsed to fine / rain / snow / high_wind / fog / other / unknown.
reasons.weekday: Day of week (0=Mon..6=Sun) from date (falls back to the STATS19 day_of_week code).

model_features_unavailable.pedestrian_crossing_human_control: not present in the loaded data / could not be engineered
model_features_unavailable.pedestrian_crossing_physical_facilities: not present in the loaded data / could not be engineered

split.note: Test rows are stored in the processed file but are never read by train_models.py (they are dropped on load) and are only used by evaluate_models.py.
